intent: Cluster test keeping a 3-node cluster under continuous multi-client read/write/HTTPS traffic while cycling leader and follower nodes through graceful and SIGKILL restarts, checking every client response is a normal 202/756 with nothing hanging or erroring.

objects.name: GracefulFailoverTest::startClientThreads
objects.role: spawns one thread per simulated client looping read/write/HTTPS-forget commands against a rotating node, tallying response codes

objects.name: GracefulFailoverTest::test
objects.role: runs client load through a graceful leader restart, a follower restart, then repeats both with SIGKILL

misfits.why: struct members sized in setup() are shadowed by identically-named local variables re-declared inside test(); the members are written once and never read again, appearing live when they're dead

naming_quality.note: member/local name collisions (threads, counts, allresults) are actively misleading
